root_idea.summary: The root centers on setting something upright, raising it, or presenting it prominently in a stable position.
root_idea.development: From erecting or raising objects come meanings for erected markers and sacrificial stones, exertion and fatigue from sustained effort, a designated share as something set out for someone, and related notions of origin, attachment, and elevation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form نَصَبَ; the group contains the passive perfect نُصِبَتْ and the active imperative فَانْصَبْ.
Displayed as the distinct noun نَصَبٌ for fatigue and weariness.
Displayed as the distinct noun نَصِيبٌ for a share or allotted portion.
Displayed as نُصْبٌ, the Quranic noun for distress or affliction in 38:41.
Displayed as the distinct noun نُصُبٌ for erected sacrificial stones and, in 70:43, an erected marker or goal.
Displayed as the normalized feminine active-participial adjective نَاصِبَةٌ.

senses.definition: to set up, place upright, erect; to be set up or fixed upright
senses.usage_conditions: The passive Quran occurrence describes things being set upright or fixed; this sense covers the corresponding active setting-up relation.

senses.definition: to apply oneself, labor, or exert oneself
senses.usage_conditions: In the imperative فَانْصَبْ after completing a task or prayer, the construction is interpreted as applying oneself in supplication or voluntary worship.
A noun for the state or burden of physical or other exertion; Quranic contexts deny or describe such fatigue.

senses.definition: a share, portion, lot, or allotted part
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun denotes a portion assigned or belonging to someone, including a share of property, reward, authority, or worldly provision.
In بِـنُصْبٍ, the noun denotes an afflicting burden or distress accompanying a trial.

senses.definition: erected stones used as sacrificial altars or objects of pagan worship
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural refers to stones set up for sacrifice or associated with worship other than God, including the altars mentioned in the prohibition of sacrificial practices.

senses.definition: an erected marker, sign, or goal toward which one hastens
senses.usage_conditions: In 70:43, the word is understood either as an erected sign or as a goal toward which people rush; the supplied lexical evidence preserves both interpretations.
The feminine active-participial adjective describes people engaged in exhausting labor and consequently wearied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to put or lay down a thing
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported, opposite-direction use of the same verb, explicitly noted as contrary to setting something up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to set a person or thing up as an obstacle, target, or object to encounter
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes setting someone up as a butt for archers or as an object against which one goes to meet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to be appointed or set up for a public task
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use for appointing someone to maintain or improve a town or district.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to have or be characterized by erect bodily features
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to erect ears or horns and to an elevated breast in animals; the cited examples establish these physical-feature uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a distinctive Arab song, chant, or melodic recitation
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with raising or elevating the voice and includes a kind of camel-driving chant or modulation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a technical quality of verse-rhyme that is free from defects
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a complete, unshortened verse whose rhyme is properly formed; the term is not applied in the cited explanation when the verse is curtailed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to pronounce or write a word with naṣb, the accusative or fatḥa inflection
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical use concerning the final letter or vowel of a word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to act with hostility toward someone, openly oppose him, or make war upon him
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form I construction and the Form III construction are both attested for hostile opposition, enmity, or war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to give someone firm counsel or a course of advice
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The counsel is presented as something from which the recipient should not deviate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to cause someone pain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may be a disease or another source of pain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to travel diligently, exerting oneself in one's pace or journey
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized travel use covering sustained or energetic progress, including journeying through the day or night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become fatigued, suffer difficulty, or experience distress
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This verbal state is distinct from the imperative use meaning to apply oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to erect or raise repeatedly or intensively
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited construction describes horses repeatedly or strongly erecting their ears; the gemination carries frequentative or intensive force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to fatigue, tire, or weary someone or something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, an affair, grief, or anxiety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to attribute or ascribe a report to someone
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction انصب الحديث إلى denotes tracing or assigning a tradition to its transmitter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to assign or give someone a share or portion
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is used causatively with the noun نَصِيبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to fit a handle to a knife
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object fitted is the knife handle, نِصَابٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to stand around or take up positions around something
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited construction describes she-asses standing around a male ass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to divide something into lots or portions among themselves
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal distribution construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to become upright, erect, vertical, or standing out
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of people, objects, hair, or teeth that stand erect or project outward; it may include raising the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to rise high
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited specialized subject is dust rising upward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: to set up a cooking-pot upon a trivet or support
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An imperative construction addressed to a cook.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an erection of the penis
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: rising high or standing out
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to rising dust, full-grown hair standing out, and teeth projecting forward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a conspicuous object, a thing in full view
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes something manifest and prominently before one's eye, including an object that is lying or thrown down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: disease or an affliction caused by disease
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical specialization reported alongside the broader sense of distress and hardship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: difficulty, trouble, distress, or affliction
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical noun sense distinct from the Quranic contexts specifically glossed as fatigue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: diseased, sick, or in pain
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person or creature suffering illness or pain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: markers or boundary stones indicating the limits of the sacred territory
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural use for signs set up to mark the boundaries of the sanctuary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a laid snare, plot, stratagem, or artifice
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete sense is a snare; the figurative sense is a plotted device or stratagem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the place of sunset or the place to which the sun returns
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geographic or astronomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the handle of a knife
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The handle is the part into which the blade is set.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the minimum amount of property that makes alms-tax due
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal-economic use for the qualifying threshold of wealth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a tank or cistern
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical noun use distinct from نَصِيبٌ meaning a share.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a set snare or fowler's net
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete net is understood as something set or set up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: stones set around a cistern, with their interstices filled with clay
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The stones may also mark the quantity of water sufficient for camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: grief, anxiety, or a condition that fatigues and troubles
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may describe something that causes fatigue, severe trouble itself, or a laborious and troublesome life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a sect characterized by open hostility toward ʿAlī
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A historical sectarian designation explained through the hostility sense of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: the raised eye of the serpent called shujāʿ
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical expression describing the eye as raised to look.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a raised, watchful gaze
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the cited poetic comparison, the expression describes an eye or gaze raised to observe something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an origin, source, point of reference, or place from which something grows or is set
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote a person's origin or lineage and the source or place to which a person or thing is referred.

other_classical_meanings.definition: rank, station, nobility, or elevated quality
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Classical use includes eminence derived from ancestry or office-like status, and can extend to beauty as an elevating quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a post, office, function, or magistracy
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or post-Classical specialization understood as the place or station in which someone is set or elevated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: an iron support or trivet on which a cooking-pot is set
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete implement for setting up a cooking-pot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: fatigue, labor, trouble, or a cause of them
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote either the burden itself or something that produces fatigue or trouble.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a set snare, stratagem, trick, plot, or chess maneuver
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete sense is a net or snare set in place; the substantivized figurative sense is an artifice or stratagem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: a horse whose bones are characteristically erect so that it stands upright without bending
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the horse's bodily conformation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: broad, thin stones set upright one upon another
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial description of stones arranged vertically.

other_classical_meanings.definition: evenly aligned teeth or foreteeth
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The teeth are understood as set up and made even.

cautions: The two Quranic nominal patterns نَصَبٌ and نُصْبٌ are kept distinct: the supplied evidence supports fatigue for نَصَبٌ and distress or affliction for نُصْبٌ.
نُصُبٌ has both an altar or pagan-sacrificial-stone sense and a Quranic marker-or-goal interpretation in 70:43; both are retained rather than reduced to the contextual English gloss alone.
The QAC verb group is normalized to نَصَبَ while preserving separate Quranic senses for being set upright and for exerting oneself.
